packet.prompt:
Read only the supplied manuscript images. Do not search for the text, open a
catalogue or edition, or consult an earlier transcription. Do not identify the
work or author. If prior context has already revealed a proposed identification
or reading, stop and report that exposure instead of calling this a blind reading.

Begin with a brief image-only layout survey. Note orientation, columns, running
titles, rubrics, enlarged initials, underlined text, and interlinear or marginal
glosses when visible. Distinguish observations from tentative interpretations
such as main text with commentary. Do not infer author, work, date, or provenance.
A tight crop may not show the layout; say so rather than guessing.

Use those features to choose a few useful spans: headings or question openings,
then connecting prose, transitions or citation chains. Keep quoted lemmata and
commentary separate. Read enough surrounding prose to make a later source match
checkable; a full transcription is not required. State which areas you selected
and which remain unread. Suggest a wider view or an adjacent crop if needed.

Transcribe those spans, preserving physical lines. Label each line with its
image filename and a line number counted from the top of that image. Keep columns
and marginal additions separate. Note overlapping crops rather than treating
repeated lines as additional text.

Retain abbreviation marks when possible. Put proposed expansions in parentheses,
uncertain readings before a question mark, and unreadable text in [illegible].
Describe visible deletions and additions explicitly. Do not supply missing words
from what would make grammatical or philosophical sense. Leave uncertainty visible.

Return the reading as UTF-8 plain text. Include limitations (cropped lines, damage,
uncertain column order) in that same response. This is an unverified image reading.

packet-07 - unverified image reading (UTF-8 plain text)

Exposure note: no proposed identification or reading of this packet appeared in my context. My context did contain the user's general memory index, which mentions manuscript-fragment projects in general terms, but nothing about this record.

LAYOUT SURVEY (image-001, reduced overview of face 1)
- Single leaf, upright, ruler 0-14 cm below. Leaf approx. 13.5 cm wide; text block in the upper ~2/3, lower third blank apart from a faint pencil/ink mark (shelfmark-like scribble, not read).
- Two columns, about 30 written lines each. Left margin wide (stub/fold at left edge). Right column runs up to the right edge; line ends of right column partly cut/damaged at right (tears near lines ~19-21 and at bottom right).
- Small cursive Gothic book hand (cursiva/bastarda-like), heavily abbreviated, brown ink. Red touches: small red paragraph marks / capital strokes within the lines (e.g. left col lines ~10, 13, 17, 20, 23, 34; right col lines ~2, 8, 19, 22, 30-31, 34). One larger red-touched initial C (left col ~line 10) and Q (left col ~line 34 "Quatuor").
- Marginal addition: small note between columns at left col ~line 17 (two short words, faint).
- Many dark round spots (ink drops/holes) scattered, obscuring a few letters.
- Content observation: left column vocabulary "motus ... latitudo ... intensio ... uniformiter difformis ..." (natural-philosophy prose); right column "forma ... materia ... piramis ... circulus ... centrum ... circumferentia". Tentative: continuous prose, no lemma/commentary distinction visible.
- Tiles image-002..005 should cover face 1; image-006 is presumably the overview of face 2, tiles 007..010.

LAYOUT SURVEY (image-006, reduced overview of face 2)
- Same leaf, other face, upright. Two columns, ~30 lines each. Left column (here at the left, written near the outer/left edge) heavily stained brown (glue/paste staining from former binding use), with a large stained irregular area along its right side; its text is darker and harder but mostly visible. Right column: top ~4 lines under the brown stain, a loss/abrasion at top centre; remainder on cleaner parchment.
- Same hand and red touches (small red strokes in left col lines ~3, 17-19, 24; right col lines ~10-12, 21, 24, 28).
- A rectangular stamp at bottom right is visible ("BIBL. UNIV. GENT"), and a faint second stamp at bottom centre; noted as observed only.
- Content observation: again motus / latitudo / intensio / uniformiter / difformiter vocabulary in both columns.
- Tiles image-007..010 should cover face 2.
